remarks: MUST SEE!!! SPACIOUS & beautifully appointed luxury condo in East Amherst; MOVE-IN READY with highly rated Williamsville schools and attractive finishes throughout. This desirable end-unit, townhome style home rests in a peaceful development steps from fantastic amenities including tennis & racquetball courts, golf course, three pools, a community building, walking paths, Ransom Creek and more! Featuring a charming kitchen with wood cabinetry, distinctive Corian counters, undermount sink & tile floors flowing through the dining area w/sliding glass door to step out onto the rear concrete patio, perfect for sipping your morning coffee. Enjoy the generous living room w/engineered hardwood and an abundance of natural light with three bright & roomy bedrooms upstairs and a potential 4th bedroom in the basement with egress window. Impeccably kept w/choice finishes and an assigned parking place directly out front with a partially finished basement for entertaining, in-unit laundry for EASE OF LIVING, and ample closets providing optimal storage. This picturesque home has many updates including a brand-new Lennox furnace & A/C 2025, sump pump 2023, kitchen 2019, Anderson windows 2018, and HWT 2013! Low taxes, great schools and close to so many conveniences! Showings begin Wednesday, 10/21/2026. Open House Thursday 10/22/2026 from 4:00-6:00 pm.
